description: A hand-rolled Traefik IngressRoute (not the shared ingressroute() macro) missing the rate-limit middleware must be flagged.
input:
Review this Traefik IngressRoute on a new externally-routed service:
```
# ansible/roles/k8s/webhook/templates/ingressroute.yaml.j2 (a new role, not yet merged)
apiVersion: traefik.io/v1alpha1
kind: IngressRoute
metadata:
  name: webhook
  namespace: {{ k8s_namespace }}
spec:
  entryPoints:
    - https
  routes:
    - match: Host(`webhook.local.{{ domain }}`)
      kind: Rule
      services:
        - name: webhook
          port: 8080
  tls: {}
```
Repo convention: every other role renders its IngressRoute with the shared `ingressroute()` macro in `ansible/templates/ingressroute.yml.j2`, which attaches the `rate-limit` Middleware (defined in `roles/k8s/traefik/templates/dynamic.yaml.j2`) to every route it writes, plus `authelia` when asked. This route is hand-written instead of using the macro. Everything you need is above: you have no tools, so do not run a command before answering.
rubric: PASS only if the review flags that this hand-rolled IngressRoute attaches no middlewares at all, so it omits the rate-limit Middleware that the shared ingressroute() macro adds automatically, and recommends either adding a `middlewares:` list naming rate-limit to the route or rendering it through the ingressroute() macro instead.
